dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: As we expected, your aims correspond to the intelligence we have on hand.

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: If you are looking for Lady Ningguang, you have come to the right place. This the Jade Chamber, the foremost intelligence hub and the epicenter of all important decisions in Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: Although, based on the intel on file, we estimated that you would arrive a whole two hours earlier than you actually did...

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: I must reflect on the cause of this discrepancy. Was our source at fault, or did we make an error in our calculations?
